nodes.name: kp_misc_stats.R
nodes.summary: Authenticated KenPom scrapers for miscellaneous men's college-basketball pages — trends, officials/referee, home-court advantage, arenas, game attributes, and FanMatch projections. Uses an httr2 cookie-jar session plus rvest CSS-selector parsing.
nodes.languageNotes: Each exported kp_* function pulls one authenticated KenPom HTML page and parses fragile CSS-selected tables with rvest.

nodes.name: kp_ratings_tables.R
nodes.summary: Authenticated KenPom scrapers for season ratings tables — Pomeroy ratings, efficiency, four-factors, point distribution, height/experience, foul trouble, team/player stats, and KPOY award tracking.

nodes.name: kp_team_tables.R
nodes.summary: Authenticated KenPom scrapers for team-level detail pages — schedule, game plan, opponent tracker, roster/players, player career, minutes matrix, per-player stats, depth chart, and lineups. The largest KenPom module in the package.

nodes.name: kp.R
nodes.summary: Documentation-only overview hub for the KenPom scraper family, cataloguing the kp_* functions and describing the httr2 cookie-jar login() auth flow that reads KP_USER/KP_PW credentials.

nodes.name: load_crosswalk.R
nodes.summary: Loaders that download pre-built cross-source crosswalk tables (team / schedule / player) for NBA and MBB from the sportsdataverse-data releases, validating seasons and tagging results.

nodes.name: load_hoopR.R
nodes.summary: Documentation-only overview hub for the hoopR data loaders, cataloguing the load_nba_* and load_mbb_* season loaders that pull pre-scraped data from the hoopR-{nba,mbb}-data releases.

nodes.name: load_mbb.R
nodes.summary: Season-level MBB data loaders pulling pre-scraped play-by-play, box scores, schedules, rosters, stats, standings, and officials from sportsdataverse-data releases, with parallel download, optional progressr progress, and DBI database build/update helpers.

nodes.name: load_nba.R
nodes.summary: Season-level NBA data loaders pulling pre-scraped play-by-play, box scores, schedules, rosters, stats, standings, draft, and officials from sportsdataverse-data releases, with parallel download and DBI database build/update helpers.

nodes.name: mbb_crosswalk.R
nodes.summary: Builds MBB cross-source crosswalks (team / schedule / player) by reconciling ESPN, Fox, Barttorvik, and KenPom identities through normalization, alias tables, and fuzzy matching atop the shared .bb_* crosswalk engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin assembler wrappers over the .bb_* engine in crosswalk_basketball.R; carries MBB-specific KP/Fox alias maps for team-name reconciliation.

nodes.name: nba_crosswalk.R
nodes.summary: Builds NBA cross-source crosswalks (team / schedule / player) reconciling ESPN, NBA Stats, and Fox identities via the shared .bb_* normalization and fuzzy-matching engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin wrappers over the .bb_* engine in crosswalk_basketball.R.

nodes.name: nba_data_pbp.R
nodes.summary: Provides nba_data_pbp(), a loader for tidy NBA play-by-play data scraped from the data.nba.com feed for a given game id.

nodes.name: nba_datasets.R
nodes.summary: Tidy reshaping helpers that flatten raw NBA Stats payloads into analysis-ready frames — franchise history, player box scores with team context, and nested player profiles.

nodes.name: nba_dictionaries.R
nodes.summary: Reference-data helpers exposing NBA player/team dictionaries and URL builders for player headshots and team logos.

nodes.name: nba_metrics.R
nodes.summary: Vectorized basketball analytics primitives — true shooting, eFG%, free-throw rate, game score, assist/turnover ratios, possessions, pace, offensive/defensive/net ratings, usage, and the four factors.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure vectorized formula functions with a private .nz() null-guard helper; no network I/O.

nodes.name: nba_reduce.R
nodes.summary: Set-combination utilities for multi-table NBA Stats results — bind, join, and nest lists of named data frames into a single structure.

nodes.name: nba_scaling.R
nodes.summary: Box-score scaling helpers that rescale counting stats to per-N-minutes or per-N-possessions and append advanced metrics, with a private column-finder helper.

nodes.name: nba_stats_boxscore_v3.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats v3 boxscore endpoints — traditional, advanced, misc, scoring, usage, four-factors, player-track, matchups, hustle, defensive, game rotation, and summary. The largest boxscore module in the package.

nodes.name: nba_stats_boxscore.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats v2/legacy boxscore endpoints — traditional, advanced, defensive, four-factors, misc, scoring, usage, summary, matchups, player-track, hustle, and similarity scores.

nodes.name: nba_stats_cume.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats cumulative-stats endpoints covering player and team cumulative totals and per-game cumulative breakdowns.

nodes.name: nba_stats_draft.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats draft endpoints — draft board, draft history, and the full draft-combine suite (measurements, drills, shooting, anthro).

nodes.name: nba_stats_franchise.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats franchise endpoints — franchise leaders (with and without rank), franchise players, and franchise history.

nodes.name: nba_stats_hustle.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats league hustle-stats endpoints covering player and team hustle stats plus their leaderboards.

nodes.name: nba_stats_leaders.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats leaders/leaderboard endpoints — all-time grids, assist leaders/tracker, homepage leaders, leader tiles, defense hub, league leaders, and dunk/gravity score leaders.

nodes.name: nba_stats_league_dash.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for the NBA Stats leaguedash endpoints — player/team stats, clutch, bio, shot dashboards (opponent, point, shot locations), and tracking defend/stats. One of the largest endpoint modules.

nodes.name: nba_stats_league.R
nodes.summary: Wrappers for league-wide NBA Stats endpoints — game log, standings (legacy + v3), playoff picture, game finder, and in-season tournament standings.
